name: q8_w4_contvel_kernel_read

operators: W4 categorical predictive-impedance write port (innovation-only, single field write path)
continuous-direction spectral Cayley transport (token-steered control path)
kernel_r1 characteristic readout (field plus current-token embedding)

belief.write_action: event-norm admittance port on the categorical prediction residual
belief.read_action: characteristic kernel probes over the field and current-token embedding

training.state_rule: field and precision persist across chunks and updates; truncation detaches gradient history only

ablation_note: Isolates the readout and transport-steering factors from the 0.205-nat gap to the Continuous-Q8 baseline while keeping the W4 single-write-path discipline on the field: the direction controller steers streaming but writes no content, and the kernel readout consumes the observed token at read time, not the field.
